title: Took vg-paradigms release 2026.10.19 by its auto subscription
body:
The dry run broke nothing: no rule it would newly break, no license it would block. What moved:
- + checks.contract: Every test and benchmark command, whatever runs it: exits 0 when it passes, 1 when it fails, and 2 when it finds it can't run here (the reason on stderr), so a missing GPU is never a pass. It never prompts, runs from the repo root on the pinned runtime with `--locked`, uses no network unless it declares it, and changes nothing, or changes idempotently with a dry run. It declares what it needs from the estate's capability vocabulary (kvm, cuda, vivado, os:windows, arch:aarch64), never which machine, and gives machine-readable results on request (JUnit or JSON for tests, a number with its unit for benchmarks). A benchmark runs on the real machine, alone, best of N, and its results are compared only with the same machine's. Gates are tend's, not the project's code: a condition on a test's or benchmark's result with a level, the defaults coming from the profiles, and a blocking one is a rule.
